P3Passive

Mute / Switch

Four switches for any signal

Four channels, each with two inputs, a toggle switch and an output. The switch selects the input; an unpatched input means silence.

  • Use as mute or as A/B selector
  • For audio, CV, gates and pitch
  • Passive, needs no power
Width8 HP · 40.4 mm
Height3 U · 128.5 mm
Jacks12
Switches and buttons4
Powerpassive, no power
